read.thesis: Telecom incumbent with steady margins: EBITDA +8.0% at constant FX, margin 39.9%, capex down to MxP 21.6bn from 24.7bn, net debt/EBITDA 1.41x; no supply-side red flags, but no numeric guidance given.

capex.quote: Our cash flow covered 21.6 billion pesos in capital expenditures, 1.4 billion pesos in share buybacks and 1.5 billion pesos in labor obligations

triggers.label: Capex MxP 24.7bn → 21.6bn YoY
triggers.quote: Our cash flow covered 21.6 billion pesos in capital expenditures

triggers.label: Mexico: Telcel EBITDA margin 42.3%
triggers.quote: The EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 42.3%, an increase of 40 basis points

red_flags.label: Chile one-off legal income inflates EBITDA
red_flags.quote: Combined EBITDA reached CLP 118 billion, reflecting the impact of extraordinary income resulting from a favorable litigation outcome in Chile

red_flags.label: Mexico prepaid disconnections from ID registration
red_flags.quote: disconnected 482 thousand prepaid subs in the context of the process of the clients registration mandated by the Digital Transformation Agency
